title: Bolus Calculator on Xdrip
symptom: The user asks if there is a bolus calculator function in the app, suggesting a feature to input carbs and show insulin dose based on carb ratio.
fix: Enable the 'show insulin / carbo ratio' option to see the bolus estimation. Also, enable 'Predictive Simulation' and 'Show Bolus Wizard Preview'.
evidence_quote: But I already found the setting, and I couldn't see it beacause I had to enable the "show insulin / carbo ratio" option.
